# UMG C2PA Validator Service

Local macOS demonstration: real C2PA inspection alongside clearly simulated music-intake modules.

- [Source and quick start](https://github.com/jeremybboy/umg-c2pa-validator-service)
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md)
- [Agent contract](AGENTS.md)
- [Contribution guide](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Security](SECURITY.md)

AI detection and DDEX are illustrative. Never infer AI use from missing credentials or confuse test-anchor trust with production trust.
